items.title: 'Make it stop': 10 minutes of chaos in Lebanon's 'Black Wednesday'
items.description: The Israel Defense Forces labelled it Operation Eternal Darkness. Inside Lebanon, it's now called Black Wednesday. ABC NEWS Verify has geolocated the explosions across 10 minutes of chaos.

items.title: Live: Trump says Iran war going 'swimmingly' as Lebanon says Israel violated ceasefire
items.description: Several hours into the ceasefire between Israel and Lebanon, the Lebanese Army says "a number of violations" have occurred. Follow live.

items.title: Breaking: Ben Roberts-Smith leaves jail after securing bail over alleged war crimes
items.description: Ben Roberts-Smith was granted bail after spending a week in custody over alleged war crime of murder offences.

items.title: Government advisory group urges delay of NDIS 'robo' changes
items.description: The federal government has been urged by its own NDIS advisory group to delay the rollout of a controversial new way of determining support plans for participants.

items.title: Young people leaving Sydney 'en mass' over housing affordability
items.description: Productivity Commissioner Danielle Wood says Australia will not meet the federal government's 1.2 million new home target, as residential construction rates fall.

items.title: Pacific leaders declare emergency over potential fuel shortages
items.description: The prime minister of Solomon Islands says Pacific leaders have declared an emergency over the looming threat of fuel shortages, while the Australian government contemplates a plan which could see stocks of diesel held by the US military sent to Pacific nations suffering shortages.

items.title: Australian woman killed in alleged DV murder in the US
items.description: A woman from the NSW Central Coast has died from stab wounds allegedly inflicted by her husband at their home in the US state of Florida.

items.title: Europe was a word British PMs dared not say. Then Donald Trump returned
items.description: Keir Starmer was never a fan of Brexit. Now, under the cover of the war in Iran and a fractured US relationship, he's looking to Europe to return Britain to the fold.

items.title: Travellers in Europe may face major flight disruption over jet fuel crisis
items.description: Europe could experience major flight disruptions within weeks as global energy officials warn the continent has "maybe six weeks of jet fuel left", which could lead to further price hikes and cancellations for Australian travellers.

items.title: Chinese device found in strategic waters near Bali identified
items.description: A large torpedo-shaped device discovered near an island in a strategically important strait between Bali and Lombok has been identified by defence analysts as a Chinese undersea monitoring system.

items.title: 'Australians deserve to know': Victorian political donations site goes dark
items.description: Victoria has been left without laws to govern party donation disclosures — exposing the state's politics to a flood of unchecked donations.

items.title: Mental health nurse jailed for 'upskirting' videos and rape of teenager
items.description: A former West Australian mental health nurse has been sentenced to 12 years in jail after being convicted for persistent sexual abuse of a teenager and making "upskirting" videos of women and children.

items.title: Mayor fears hidden cameras may have been in town hall change rooms for years
items.description: The Horsham mayor is worried that hidden cameras reportedly found in the town hall theatre change rooms could have been there for years.

items.title: Live: Raiders make red-hot start against struggling Storm
items.description: Canberra crosses twice in the opening 10 minutes as Melbourne's horror start to the season continues in the nation's capital. Follow live.

items.title: AI Val Kilmer branded 'terrifying', but filmmakers say movie is ethical
items.description: A trailer for a film with an AI-generated character in the likeness of the late Val Kilmer has been slammed by social media users, but the filmmakers are defending their work.

items.title: How mobile phone cameras have helped unearth a mysterious kingdom
items.description: An exhibition bridges the gap between art and science by inviting visitors to imagine the world through the senses of other species and consider our own fragile relationship with nature.

items.title: Weekly news quiz: Trump's AI image, a 200m record and the Artemis II splashdown
items.description: It's Friday, and that means it's time to test your news knowledge from the past seven days. Were you paying attention this week?

items.title: What we know about the 'small fire' that became an 'unprecedented' Geelong refinery blaze
items.description: The "unprecedented" fire at one of the two remaining oil refineries in Australia took more than 12 hours to extinguish. Here's what we know about how it unfolded.

items.title: Australia is on the verge of aged care AI boom
items.description: Artificial intelligence-enabled robot companions, personal behaviour monitors and pain management apps could soon be used more widely within the sector.

items.title: Oil refinery fire will not push Australia to fuel plan 'stage three', PM says
items.description: Anthony Albanese has cut a trip to Malaysia short to visit Viva Energy Refinery in Geelong, which went up in flames late on Wednesday.

items.title: In charts: A look at Australia's record spending on defence
items.description: The Defence Department reveals where the money will be going as Australia plans to spend a record $425 billion over the next decade.

items.title: Some Australians fear lockdowns. Economists say stagflation is the bigger risk
items.description: As fuel costs surge and supply fears grow, businesses and households say the economic shock from the war in the Middle East is already hitting home.

items.title: Custom thongs, hugs and selfies: Harry and Meghan's very Sydney visit
items.description: The Duke and Duchess of Sussex spoke with lifeguards who responded to the December 14 Bondi Beach terror attack and survivors.

items.title: 'Never thought we'd be homeless': Mother of 13 pleads for help
items.description: Finding a home for a large family in a regional area has left one family camping on the side of the highway in rural New South Wales. Nationally, Indigenous people are over-represented in homelessness statistics.

items.title: 'Double jeopardy, isn't it?' Inmate's bid for freedom after accidental release
items.description: A prisoner who was mistakenly released from a northern New South Wales prison this week has been returned to jail to complete his sentence.
